result.rationale: Sources concern Enwave Energy Corporation and its Canadian business; none supports a standalone U.S. Corporation. The row is a detached legal suffix matched to canonical Enwave.

identityResolution.parsingFinding: Corporation was detached from the phrase 'owned by Enwave Energy Corporation'.

ownershipResolution.holdingStructure: Each current owner holds 50% through an SPV. The joint downstream SPV name is NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED; IFM GIF owns Global InfraCo Sarl, whose holdings include Enwave Canada Investment Holdings Inc.
ownershipResolution.currentCheck: IFM reported 50% as of 2026-06-30; Enwave names both investors. No later owner change found.

operatingResolution.includedBoundary: The deal covered 100% of Canadian operations in Toronto, London, Windsor and Charlottetown and retained the Enwave brand.
operatingResolution.excludedBoundary: Enwave Energy US was sold separately to QIC and Ullico, closed 2021-07-16 and became CenTrio.
operatingResolution.projectBoundary: Systems, plants, projects and project entities are components, not a company called Corporation.

acquisitionExitCheck.laterTransactions: No equity recapitalization, exit, owner change or signed pending ownership deal found through the cutoff; financings did not change ownership.

2021-07-16: Separate U.S. sale closed to QIC/Ullico and became CenTrio.
